verdict.rationale: Adyen documents merchant-side integration paths for accepting agent traffic. With the Agentic Cart API, the merchant exposes a server that Adyen calls (including optional commit and cancel session hooks). The Feed API lets merchants upload catalog batches that are synced to OpenAI and Meta, and a Google agentic commerce guide is also published. That covers the 'publish an endpoint' element as a documented path. However, nothing shows activation is self-serve: there is no dashboard toggle, click-through agreement, or sign-up flow, so onboarding may still require Adyen involvement. Missing for 10: evidence of a self-serve enablement step (setting or agreement), clarity on eligibility or activation without Adyen contact, independent or hands-on corroboration.
